instruction:
Learning Center Drawing Set

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 7 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 2 IfcSlab entities, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 1 IfcStair entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: LOBBY, CLASSROOM-1, OFFICE, WC, STAIR, CLASSROOM-2, MAKER.
7. LOBBY, CLASSROOM-1, OFFICE, WC, STAIR are assigned to one storey; and CLASSROOM-2, MAKER are assigned to a second storey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [10.0, 10.0, 6.7].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf has exactly 3 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, LEARNING CENTER, CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, MAKER, LOBBY, SECTION.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
